仕事概要
フィギュアやキャラクターグッズ・ドール等のPOP UP STORE企画・運営、イベント物販、および委託販売業務全般をお任せします。
▼部署ミッション
全国の主要都市へPOP UP STOREを波及させ、GSCブランドの認知と作品価値を最大化することです。近年のエンタメ市場の盛り上がりも牽引し、POP UP STOREの売り上げは昨年対比で倍以上へと成長しています。
イベントや期間限定ショップの企画・運営を通じて、ファンを熱狂させるリアルな接点をつくり出すことに貢献してください。
1. POP UP STORE（期間限定ショップ）の企画・運営（現在のメイン業務） 
・企画・立案・打診：開催地域・店舗の選定、商業施設への打診・交渉
・準備・施工：図面作成・施工発注、契約締結手続き、販売商品リスト作成 
・店舗づくり・陳列：展示サンプルの手配、陳列シミュレーション、アイキャッチ効果を高める店舗レイアウト構想 
・当日の運用・データ分析：搬入・設営・撤収作業、売上報告、販促施策の実行
2.イベント物販業務 
自社・他社大型イベントでの販売：グッドスマイルフェス（GSC主催）、Wonder Festival、コミックマーケット、AnimeJapan等でのブース設営・混雑緩和のための動線設計・物販運営 
3.委託販売業務 
他社イベント等への商品提供：版権元・他社催事への商品提案リスト作成、掛け率の交渉 
【採用背景】
POP UP STOREの売上急拡大に伴う、体制強化のための増員募集です。全国主要都市での期間限定ショップの開催が大幅に増加していることに加え、中長期的な新規展開へのリソース投入を進めています。拡大し続ける催事・イベントの企画・運営を安定して牽引し、さらなる事業成長を共に推進していただける方を迎えます。
【ポジションの魅力】
・自由度の高い空間プロデュース
単に商品を陳列するだけでなく、作品の世界観に合わせた演出やサンプルの見せ方、作品ごとの棚の組み替えなど、現場のアイデアや判断を活かしてファンを魅了する売場をつくりあげることができます。
・企画から店舗立ち上げまで手掛ける面白さ
商業施設や大型書店への提案・アプローチから、期間限定ショップの立ち上げ、常設店舗のオープンまで、一連のプロセスに幅広く携われるやりがいがあります。
・手応えをダイレクトに感じられる環境
自分が企画・設営した店舗で、お客様が足を止め、ワクワクしながら商品を手に取る瞬間を間近で見ることができます。現場での反応や売上データを分析し、次の施策へスピーディーに活かせる面白さがあります。

About Nexon
Nexon America is a branch of Nexon Co., Ltd., a global video game publisher and leading developer of online virtual worlds for PCs, consoles, and mobile devices. Nexon proudly offers celebrated franchises like MapleStory and Mabinogi that have been enjoyed by millions of players for over two decades. When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free-to-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day.
But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. Nexies find support, friendship, and career growth all in one place! And because we know a healthy work-life balance is the key to happiness, Nexies also enjoy flexible hours, a hybrid work model, and extra perks like food trucks, happy hours, and team events. It’s why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work certification for 6 years running!
We’re looking to expand our team with passionate individuals who want to learn, play, and grow with us. Ready for a new challenge?
Summary of Position
As a key member of the Market Intelligence team, this role supports the development and leads execution of data-driven marketing strategies aimed at increasing acquisition and engagement of Asian American gamers. This role bridges data-driven consumer insights with actionable marketing execution, ensuring campaigns effectively resonate with Asian American gamers and align with broader business objectives.
This individual will identify Asian American market opportunities, analyze consumer behavior, evaluate campaign effectiveness, lead go-to-market campaign planning and execution, partner with agencies, and cross-functionally with marketing, product, content, and leadership teams to shape strategic initiatives.
We are currently working in the office 2-3x a week in a hybrid work model.
Job Responsibilities
Asian American Understanding & Strategy Development:
Build a specialized roadmap of the platforms and social ecosystems unique to Asian American gamers (e.g., specialized Discord servers, platform-specific sub-communities, or culturally specific apps).
Execute "test-and-learn" media strategies to identify which specific platforms and messaging styles yield the highest acquisition for Asian American gamers compared to general market channels.
Direct and challenge agency partners to move beyond "standard" media strategies, instead uncovering high-impact, niche opportunities for deep cultural resonance among Asian American gamers.
Convert campaign data and "trial-and-error" learnings into go-to-market frameworks that define exactly how, where, and when to reach Asian American gamers most effectively
Campaign Execution & Performance Optimization:
Lead the execution of social and digital campaigns, using A/B testing to determine which creative hooks and cultural nuances drive the strongest engagement among Asian American gamers.
Monitor KPIs across social, community, and paid media channels to "course-correct" in real-time, refining the team’s ability to find and convert the Asian American gamer.
Evaluate campaign success by isolating channel and creative effectiveness, documenting specific "wins" in Asian American gamer-specific spaces that can be repeated for future launches.
Analyze dashboards to communicate performance trends and learnings about Asian American gamer media consumption to leadership.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Serve as the strategic bridge for agencies and internal teams, ensuring that the way we talk to the Asian American gamers is authentic and avoids "one-size-fits-all" marketing.
Provide learnings and insights on Asian American gamer-specific media trends and platform shifts to ensure brand relevance.
Present findings that demonstrate the unique ROI of specialized Asian American gamer targeting, justifying the team's distinct focus through acquisition data.

5+ years of experience in Marketing Strategy, Product Marketing and/or Brand Marketing roles.
Experience developing strategic go-to marketing initiatives based on audience insights in gaming.
Experience in navigating and utilizing Chinese social media ecosystems preferred (e.g. RedNote, Bilibili, WeChat, and Weibo).
Experience mentoring junior team members
Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, Data Analytics, or related field.
Knowledge/Skills
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills with experience using consumer data, performance metrics, and research tools.
A demonstrated, sustained engagement with Chinese American communities and a nuanced understanding of their cultural, social, and consumer dynamics is strongly preferred
